criteria.reason: Concrete, accurate guidance on punctuality (arrive early to prepare), Sie-until-Du-offered, and feedback with a usable example.
Norms framed as tendencies ('meist', 'normalerweise'); differences called normal; no stereotypes of Swiss or Sri Lankans.
Friendly, encouraging German suited to a worried newcomer; warm and appropriately formal register.

summary: Direct, concrete, respectful German guidance on Swiss workplace norms (punctuality, Sie/Du, feedback) with further practical help and no refusal, stereotyping, or moralising.
